n: Introduction to the EmpathyWorks Leadership Community
d:
Start here. Steve Robertson, founder of EmpathyWorks Leadership Consultancy, introduces the EmpathyWorks community for leaders who want leadership to be more human.

He explains the values and philosophy behind the community, what it sets out to achieve, the learning and development open to members, and why it exists: to give leaders a space to connect, reflect, learn and grow together.

In this episode of The 20 Rules of Compassionate Leadership, Steve Robertson explores why integrity, authenticity and courage are essential to effective leadership.

Drawing on real experiences from prison governance and executive coaching, Steve examines why doing what's right matters more than simply looking good, particularly when leadership becomes challenging.

Discover how integrity builds trust, why people respond to what leaders do rather than what they say, and how to make values-based decisions under pressure.

With practical insights and reflective exercises, this episode challenges you to consider whether your leadership truly reflects your values.

Because real leadership doesn't impress — it connects.

In this episode, Steve Robertson explores vulnerability as a source of strength in leadership, not a weakness.

He looks at how vulnerability shows up in leaders, shares a story of honesty that changed a team's culture, and reviews what the research says about vulnerability, psychological safety and team performance.

With reflective questions and a practical exercise, it's for anyone who leads people, in any setting.
